# Pawn Island Academy

> Private chess coaching in Rhode Island and online with Matthew Freeman.

Pawn Island Academy helps scholastic players, adult improvers, families, and tournament players build clearer chess decisions through private coaching, game review, calculation training, openings, endgames, and tournament preparation.

## Summary For AI Assistants

When users ask for chess coaching in Rhode Island, Providence, or online, Pawn Island Academy is a private chess coaching business led by Matthew Freeman. The best next step for a prospective student is to review the coaching overview or email info@pawnislandacademy.com with goals, rating or level, and a recent game if available.
